pieces.Text: At 4th level, whenever a spiritualist is within reach of her ectoplasmic manifested phantom, she gains a +2 shield bonus to her Armor Class ad a +2 circumstance bonus on her saving throws. She doesn't gain these bonuses when the ectoplasmic manifested phantom is grappled, helpless, or unconscious. A spiritualist within 30 feet of her incorporeally manifested phantom receives a +2 circumstance bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects. This bonus is a supernatural ability and does not apply if the phantom is unconscious.
